about: Quality and speed, measured on every refactoring pass (the dev agent's mandate, WS-65): how many files a release changes, how long the build and the gate take, and how long CI takes. Append a row per pass; never edit an old one.

rows.note: before WS-83: generated pages committed
after WS-83: generated output gitignored, CI builds and deploys

dev pass 1: CI three jobs -> two (validate uploads the pages it checked; no second build in deploy); gate reads each file once and skips the 14 MB of video; key-shape regex made linear; .gitignore 241 -> 24 lines. CI after: measured on the next wake.

dev pass 2 (WS-86): one shared list of secret shapes (admin/build/secrets.cjs) for check 5 and comms_check, with fixtures the gate must catch; comms_check reads every text type (content/ waits on WS-88); .gitignore guards key files again. CI measured is v0.1.44, the first two-job run (pass 1 recorded null). Validate +0.07 s (the shared rules and self-test).

dev pass 3 (WS-91, WS-92, Dinis): layout uses the width (82rem frame, left rail), table/prompt/asterisk fixes (10 pages rendered wrong before), the cast inline from data/cast.json (no image files). Pages 184 -> 194 (the cast, the site review, collections added by others). Build 0.27 -> 0.35 s, validate 0.58 -> 0.71 s (more pages, larger pages). The cast page is 268 KB because every figure is inline (about 110 of them); if that matters, the figures move to cached SVG files.

dev pass 4: the stand-ups (admin/build/meetings.mjs) spawned git log four times per person per stand-up, about 300 processes a build; now the history is read once and filtered in memory. All 612 generated files byte-identical (BUILD_NOW fixed). CI time after: next wake.

dev pass 5: the build deletes its own stale output (a removed page made every clone that had built it fail the gate: merch-sponsor, this wake); versions as data (WS-106 item 6): versions/index.json and 112 per-version files. CI went 49 s -> 67 s between passes, before this change (more pages, two builds per release): to look at next.

dev pass 7 (WS-123 item 3, part 1): gate check 19 (me.json shape and links) and check 15 widened to the generated public JSON. Build 0.45 -> 1.64 s since pass 5, about 0.4 s of it the PKI cards drawing a QR per key (admin/build/pki.mjs, security-verified output, left to its owner).

dev pass 8 (WS-123 item 3): admin/build/charts.mjs, dayTimeline on /wakes/ (classes only, look in site.css on tokens). Build 1.64 -> 2.4 s between passes as pages landed (322 pages); not investigated this pass.

dev pass 9 (WS-123 item 3): burndown() and the chart fence in render(). Correction to the previous row (pass 8): its note says the build reached 2.4 s; that was one early measure in a busy clone, and the figure the row records, 1.36 s, is the one measured at release. Rows are never edited, so the correction is here.
dev pass 10 (WS-123 item 3 done): agentsMap() on every dashboard; one more git log read per build (the For: lines).

dev pass 11: CI was 47 -> 73 s; its build step alone took 14 s (1.5 s locally). Cause, mine: the burn-down read old board files (git log -p), and CI clones blobless, so each old file was fetched on demand. Now file names only: a cold build in a blobless clone 24.8 s -> 2.0 s, same figures (117 not done, 13 done).

dev pass 12: every gate run built the site twice (the caller, then check 9). The gate now makes its one build first (check 9 unchanged: snapshot, build, snapshot) and checks that output; release.sh and CI validate no longer pre-build. A release locally: build 1.75 s + gate 3.0 s -> gate 3.0 s. tag_release.sh (CI release step, conductor) still pre-builds twice: left to its owner. Largest build cost now: the PKI QR codes, about 0.6 s (security).

dev pass 13: personal stand-up briefings only for today and later (they showed today's numbers under an old date): 338 -> 320 pages, 1057 -> 1003 generated files, and the count no longer grows with every past stand-up. Found, not changed: the pack is 58 MiB (25 this morning); 19 MB of it is four versions of the two print zips, which are derivable from the committed files (the sign-offs hash the files, not the zip). Proposed to the designer for after the print.

dev pass 14: fixes pass 13's time bomb. Dropping past briefings at midnight broke a dashboard link and turned the gate red for every push until the conductor fixed the link. A past briefing's address now resolves to a short page (no numbers), linked from its stand-up's page; checked green as of 5 Nov 00:30 and 6 Nov 09:00 (BUILD_NOW). Pass 13's file saving is mostly given back: 18 small files per past stand-up instead of 27.
dev pass 15 (WS-74, the feedback pane's public mode): quiet window (1 commit). Gate 2.96 s at 395 pages.
dev pass 16: chart fences in markdown twins become the chart's own title and description; no twin carries a raw fence now (it was the dashboards and the site review). Gate 3.33 s at 399 pages.

dev pass 18: the key-shape check scans 36.6 MB (2,726 files; /pki/keys/ alone 2.7 MB of QR paths) and took 421 ms; a literal-led prefilter (a necessary part of every match) runs first: 33 ms, same answer for every file; a planted key still fails the gate, and a broken prefilter fails the self-test. Gate 4.4 -> 4.0 s.

dev pass: WS-132 part 1. Markdown links and images keep their URL only if http(s), mailto, a fragment or relative (safeUrl in build.mjs; also the cards fence); javascript:, data: and vbscript: render as plain text. Gate check 21 scans every href, src, action and formaction in the 465 built pages, entities decoded and control characters dropped as a browser does, with its own fixtures. Probed: nine hostile links rendered inert; with safeUrl disabled the gate fails on all five. Gate 5.2 s at 465 pages (4.7 s at 433 last pass: the growth is pages); build 3.6 s.

dev pass: the history read once per build. Profiled the build: 1.5 s in git processes, eight modules each reading the whole history for the same commits (build.mjs three times, orgchart, inventory, pki, meetings, highlights). admin/build/gitlog.mjs reads it once, memoized; each filters its own window. Output byte-identical (old and new code built back to back with BUILD_NOW pinned: only built_at differs). Build 3.87 -> 3.45 s, gate 5.27 -> 4.92 s (medians of three, 478 pages). Next: QR codes for the 49 keys are 1.2 s of the rest (pki.mjs, security's).

dev pass: WS-164 items 1 and 3. page() leaves keyring.js off any page that runs a script from people/ (resolved from its src) or a script a person's pages.mjs put on it: 34 of 492 pages (Indi's factory and today, the lab studio, the command centres with their own app.js). Gate check 22: no built page has both; no .js under people/ uses WSKeyring, ws-keyring, indexedDB, document.links or data/sealed/. Proved: with the filter off the gate fails on all 34; a planted people/ script calling WSKeyring fails. Gate 5.04 s at 492 pages (4.92 s at 478); build 3.47 s.

dev pass: one set of text helpers (admin/build/text.mjs: esc, escAttr, clipWords) for ten build modules; eight private copies of esc and two of the word-boundary clip removed. Output identical (built old and new with BUILD_NOW pinned) except the one intended change: cockpit.mjs cut commit subjects at 160 characters mid-word, the same bug sgit@ fixed in two other places (a cut agent name reads as an email address to the gate); now cut at a word. Gate 6.1 s at 500 pages, unchanged within noise (this machine read 6.0 s before the change; it was 5.0 s at 492 pages this morning, so the machine is slower now).

dev pass: admin/tools/lane_for.py runs as any agent (vault@web-summit.angelo ran it from an edited copy, 11884c6e): --as/LANE_AS, --creds/LANE_CREDS, --why for the record, today's date; and it signs with the published key that matches the creds file, not the first key with the agent's name (an ended session's key would have signed). No copy to keep in step; the site and the gate unchanged.

dev pass: WS-77 on phones: the section sub-menu is one sideways-scrolling row (Work: 40 px tall, was about 155: three rows of 16 links above the content), starting at the current page, both rows fading at the right edge. Six CSS rules and four lines in copy.js; no new script, no colour literal; desktop unchanged.

dev pass: QR codes cached in .cache/qr/ (gitignored, by sha256 of the text; the same text always makes the same code). Interleaved medians of five, old against new: build 3.99 -> 2.84 s, gate 5.75 -> 4.59 s warm (5.74 s cold, as before). Output identical (built from the cache with BUILD_NOW pinned). Gate check 10's walk skips .cache. CI starts empty, so its build is unchanged unless the workflow caches .cache/ (a suggestion for the workflow's owner). Tried first and dropped: one mkdir per folder in write() and one git log for the print sign-offs: no difference in five interleaved runs, though the profiler showed them; not shipped.

dev pass: the gate's contact check (comms_check.mjs, check 15) 933 -> 410 ms. Its email pattern is anchored at the start of a run (identical matches on all 2,101 tracked text files: 6,897 matches, 0 files differ; 465 -> 182 ms on its own), and the key shapes use secrets.cjs's prefilters, as check 5 already did. Planted email and vault-key probes still fail. Gate 4.87 -> 4.37 s, medians of five interleaved runs, 521 pages. CI gains the same half second in both jobs.
